newsitem.title: INDIA: Twenty killed in India as van hits truck-agency.
newsitem.headline: Twenty killed in India as van hits truck-agency.

text.p: Twenty people were killed and as many injured in the southern Indian state of Andhra Pradesh on Tuesday when an overcrowded van in which they were travelling collided with a truck, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
The news agency said the dead included six children and four women. The accident occurred near Dhone in the district of Kurnool, 200 km (125 miles) south of the state capital of Hyderabad.
PTI quoted police saying the van overbalanced and hit the truck. The van's driver was among the dead, it added.
